items.title: Tried out adding veg sausages to my noodles and it was rather tasty
items.text: Tried out adding veg sausages to my noodles and it was rather tasty

Sorry in advance for the vague recipe, hopefully it makes sense. I think the most important thing here is cooking everything slowly on a low heat

Ingredients: 
1L veggie stock

3 tbsp soy sauce 

2 tbsp apple cider vinegar or rice vinegar

1 tsp five spice 

1 sliced red chilli

3 tbsp sesame oil

Rice noodles

2 vegan sausages, sliced

Handful of mushrooms, sliced

2 carrots, chopped roughly

handful of peas

2 shallots, sliced

3 garlic cloves, crushed

Fresh ginger, crushed

1 spring onion, sliced

Fresh coriander, basil and mint

half a lime 

Method:
-Slowly fry the shallots, garlic and ginger in the sesame oil on a low heat

-when the shallots are nicely softened, add the sliced sausages and cook until golden

-add the sliced mushrooms (add a splash of stock and season with black pepper so they soak up lots of flavour)

-meanwhile, keep the stock on a medium heat and add the vinegar, soy sauce, chilli, five spice and carrots 

-add the rice noodles to the broth pot

-when the mushrooms and sausages are nicely cooked, serve the noodles/broth and spoon on more of the broth mixture 

-add the spring onions and herbs and squeeze over the lime
